explication: Spine Runtimes are libraries and toolkit integrations for using Spine 2D skeletal-animation data in applications. The broad workflow is author/export data, load it into a runtime, advance animation state and update the skeleton pose, then render through a platform integration. The repository supports multiple languages and engines rather than one application entry point. The graph emphasizes indexed core modules and sampled Android integration; other runtime branches are represented at directory level because their implementation details were not sampled.
